phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Scorpion EVO 3 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 9×19mm Parabellum primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 235 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 235 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 196 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 370 m/s (550 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Blowback Cycle & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 30-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Scorpion EVO 3 staged for its 1,150 RPM (Semi / 3-Round Burst / Full-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪：2009 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 沿袭捷克轻武器人机工效传统，采用全聚合物机匣、左右互换非随动拉机柄、4 档双侧快慢机（含 3 发点射）及半透明 30 发双排双进弧形弹匣，在 1,150 发/分高射速下保持顺手操控。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Scorpion EVO 3 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2009 年问世的 CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪 由捷克捷克兵工厂（Česká zbrojovka）主导研制，定位为经典的现代聚合物闭膛冲锋枪。EVO 3 源自斯洛伐克原型 Laugo 冲锋枪，2009 年由 CZ 完善量产并命名为“蝎式第三代”，已装备超过 30 国警队与特种部队。
CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 沿袭捷克轻武器人机工效传统，采用全聚合物机匣、左右互换非随动拉机柄、4 档双侧快慢机（含 3 发点射）及半透明 30 发双排双进弧形弹匣，在 1,150 发/分高射速下保持顺手操控。 整件装备总长 660 mm（折叠托 410 mm）、空重 2.77 kg，成为同期冲锋枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2009 年，捷克捷克兵工厂（Česká zbrojovka）推出了划时代的CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪。EVO 3 源自斯洛伐克原型 Laugo 冲锋枪，2009 年由 CZ 完善量产并命名为“蝎式第三代”，已装备超过 30 国警队与特种部队。 它的核心设计聚焦于四档双侧快慢机（保险 / 单发 / 3 发点射 / 1,150 RPM 全自动）贴合现代 CQB 节拍，奠定了其在冲锋枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪 的机械灵魂在于其「闭膛待击自由枪机 · 3 发点射棘轮火控 + 玻璃纤维增强聚合物机匣」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，闭膛击发后弹壳底缘克服枪机质量与复进簧阻力直线后坐完成抽抛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。非随动拉机柄可在左右侧快速互换，且具备防挂手折收与空仓释放功能，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪 采用闭膛待击自由枪机 · 3 发点射棘轮火控 + 玻璃纤维增强聚合物机匣。在每个击发周期中，闭膛击发后弹壳底缘克服枪机质量与复进簧阻力直线后坐完成抽抛。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了非随动拉机柄可在左右侧快速互换，且具备防挂手折收与空仓释放功能。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 9×19mm Parabellum 弹药规格与 196 mm 冷锻枪管 · 6 条右旋膛线（1:250 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 235 MPa，可赋予弹头 370 m/s 的出膛初速与 550 J 动能，有效作用距离达 200 米。
内膛技术特点方面，196 mm 冷锻钢枪管配鸟笼消焰器与 18×1 / 1/2×28 消音器螺纹接口。同时，高强度聚合物折合伸缩两用枪托与全周四面战术导轨高度模块化，令其在 1,150 发/分（单发 / 3 发点射 / 全自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 196 毫米身管与 9×19mm Parabellum 口径，CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪 实现了每秒 370 米的初速与 200 米有效射程。196 mm 冷锻钢枪管配鸟笼消焰器与 18×1 / 1/2×28 消音器螺纹接口，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 46 mm 膛轴设计，CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.1 N·s 水平。双排双进半透明弧形弹匣余弹直观可见，上弹阻力极低。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-64）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，双排双进半透明弧形弹匣余弹直观可见，上弹阻力极低。欢迎在 BAY-64 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 CZ 蝎式 EVO 3 A1 9mm 现代冲锋枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Scorpion EVO 3
paragraphs: Introduced in 2009 by Česká zbrojovka Uherský Brod (CZ) in Czech Republic, the CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1 emerged as a defining Modern Polymer Closed-Bolt Submachine Gun. Evolving from the Slovak Laugo prototype and finalized by CZ in 2009 as the third-generation Scorpion, the EVO 3 serves police and military forces across more than 30 countries.

The CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1 pairs a rugged glass-reinforced polymer chassis with a swappable non-reciprocating charging handle, four-position ambidextrous selector (including 3-round burst), and translucent 30-round double-feed magazines at 1,150 RPM. Measuring 660 mm (410 mm Stock Folded) at an unloaded weight of 2.77 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Submachine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2009, Česká zbrojovka Uherský Brod (CZ) of Czech Republic introduced the CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1. Evolving from the Slovak Laugo prototype and finalized by CZ in 2009 as the third-generation Scorpion, the EVO 3 serves police and military forces across more than 30 countries. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Four-position ambidextrous selector offers Semi, 3-Round Burst, and 1,150 RPM Full-Auto — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1 sits its Closed-Bolt Straight Blowback · 3-Round Burst Fire Control & Glass-Reinforced Polymer Receiver. Throughout every firing cycle, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably, containing 235 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Non-reciprocating charging handle swaps left or right in seconds with bolt hold-open, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1 relies on Closed-Bolt Straight Blowback · 3-Round Burst Fire Control & Glass-Reinforced Polymer Receiver. During each cycle, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Non-reciprocating charging handle swaps left or right in seconds with bolt hold-open.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 9×19mm Parabellum with 196 mm Cold-Hammer-Forged · 6-Groove RH Rifling (1:250 mm Twist), the CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1 develops 370 m/s muzzle velocity and 550 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 200 meters.

Internally, 196 mm cold-hammer-forged steel barrel fitted with a birdcage flash hider and suppressor threads. Combined with its 1,150 RPM (Semi / 3-Round Burst / Full-Auto) tempo, Side-folding telescoping polymer stock and quad MIL-STD-1913 rails support modular optics, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 9×19mm Parabellum through its 196 millimeter bore, the CZ Scorpion EVO 3 A1 achieves 370 meters per second and 200 meters of effective reach. 196 mm cold-hammer-forged steel barrel fitted with a birdcage flash hider and suppressor threads.
